title: Appearance
lead: How PlayOut looks and behaves on screen.

fullscreen.label: Start in fullscreen
fullscreen.description: Open PlayOut as a borderless fullscreen dashboard (F11 toggles it any time).

minimize.label: Minimize while playing
minimize.description: Hide the dashboard when a game starts and bring it back when the game ends.

clock.label: 24-hour clock
clock.description: Show the system bar clock as 19:30 instead of 7:30 PM.

recent.label: Front page games
recent.description: How many games the front page's row shows (Recently Played, Recently Added, Favorites or Most Played: Settings › Library).

animations.label: Animations
animations.description: Focus scaling, hero crossfades and modal motion. Turn off on slow machines.
